evidence.description: The manager obtains the global default notification center directly rather than receiving it as a dependency.
The directly obtained notification center performs operational behavior by posting authentication state changes.
dispatchAuthState directly accesses another type's shared registry to retrieve registered windows, without an injected dependency boundary.

candidates.explanation: The manager hard-codes operational dependencies on NotificationCenter.default and EcosiaAuthWindowRegistry.shared instead of receiving them through an explicit, replaceable boundary. These are accesses to external services, not merely a singleton declaration or the actor accessing its own shared instance.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access
